question: Why did the error rate go up on 22 March 2026?

contributing_factors.description: New deployment of checkout v1.12 to eu-west caused the error rate to rise.
why_chain: Checkout v1.12 deployment introduced a new error condition.
This new error condition affected the error rate for service catalog in region eu-west.
The error rate increased from 0.53% to 0.96%.

contributing_factors.description: The feature request for dark mode for the account page may have introduced a regression.
why_chain: Feature request for dark mode may have introduced a regression.
This regression affected the error rate for service catalog in region eu-west.
The error rate increased from 0.53% to 0.96%.

contributing_factors.description: The deployment of search v3.8 to ap-south may have caused a ripple effect.
why_chain: Deployment of search v3.8 to ap-south may have caused a ripple effect.
This ripple effect affected the error rate for service catalog in region eu-west.
The error rate increased from 0.53% to 0.96%.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The increase in error rate was due to a sudden increase in user traffic.
ruled_out.reason: Request volume and p95 latency did not change significantly.

ruled_out.hypothesis: The new admin user request affected the error rate.
ruled_out.reason: The request was made 192 minutes before the change.

evidence.summary: Error rate for service catalog in region eu-west rose from 0.53% to 0.96% (+81%), with a change point at 2026-03-22T04:30:00Z.
The change is concentrated in service catalog in region eu-west: 1 of 12 service/region segments changed; the other segments stayed flat (largest after/before ratio 1.12).
At the same time, request volume for service catalog in region eu-west stayed about the same (570 per 5 min before, 648 per 5 min after, +14%).
At the same time, p95 latency for service catalog in region eu-west stayed about the same (121 ms before, 121 ms after, +1%).
Deployed checkout v1.12 to eu-west (routine release) (checkout, eu-west; 207 min before the change; record R006)
Feature request: dark mode for the account page. (search, ap-south; 130 min before the change; record R009)
Deployed search v3.6 to eu-west (routine release) (search, eu-west; 264 min before the change; record R004)
Deployed search v3.8 to ap-south (routine release) (search, ap-south; 223 min before the change; record R005)
Request to add a new admin user to the dashboard. (search, us-east; 192 min before the change; record R007)

reasons: ✗ The closest change event is 207 min before the change, too far to be convincing.
✗ It concerns a different service/region than the one that changed.
✗ No logs or alerts from the affected segment confirm the problem.
✓ Request volume stayed steady, ruling out a traffic spike.
✓ No competing change event fits as well.
✓ The main factor rests on this event.
missing_data: Change records from the hour before the change
Change records for the affected service/region
Error logs or traces from the affected segment after the change

actions.action: Rollback the checkout v1.12 deployment to eu-west.
Monitor the checkout v1.12 deployment for any further issues.
Review the feature request for dark mode for the account page.
